request_fields: Definition (task instruction) + instance input (one sentence); files include 2-3 positive/negative few-shot examples
notes: MedS-Bench (Wu et al., npj Digit Med 2024; arXiv 2408.12547) recasts the dataset as an instruction task. Henrychur/MedS-Bench holds the full test files ("the official benchmark"); Henrychur/MedS-Bench-SPLIT holds the subsample used for the paper's results. n_items counts the MedS-Bench file. Three extraction tasks (participants, interventions, outcomes) over the same 43 sentences; n_items counts the 129 instruction instances. The MedS-Bench source field points to Zlabinger et al.'s PICO annotation of EBM-NLP sentences, not the original EBM-NLP token-level release. Checked 2026-10-04; no LLMs or API keys used.

rendering.rule: instruction-style (MedS-Bench): the task Definition, a blank line, then the instance input (few-shot examples and outputs omitted)
rendering.template_source: none (instruction and input as released in the MedS-Bench task files)
